name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 80 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 80 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli airstrikes continue to hit Gaza, killing six people including a doctor, a child and a senior Hamas commander at Nasser Hospital, while heavy rains flood tens of thousands of tents and a baby dies from cold. Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians in the West Bank, wounding several individuals, and Israeli troops occupied the home of a Palestinian-American. Kosovo fans booed and whistled the Israeli national anthem before a Nations League draw. The European Union called for immediate, unimpeded humanitarian aid to Gaza amid the flooding. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels luftangrep fortsetter å treffe Gaza, og drar seks personer, blant annet en lege, et barn og en høytstående Hamas-kommandør på Nasser-sykehuset, mens kraftig regn oversvømmer titusenvis av telt og et spedbarn dør av kulde. Israelske bosettere angrep palestinere på Vestbredden og såret flere personer, og israelske soldater okkuperte hjemmet til en palestinsk-amerikansk. Kosovo-supportere blåste og plystret i den israelske nasjonalsangen før en Nations-League-kamp endte uavgjort. Den europeiske unionen oppfordret til umiddelbar, uhindret humanitær hjelp til Gaza på grunn av flommen. De forente nasjoner rapporterte 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
